scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

places-thracian-tomb-of-kazanlak-central.story: 98 km from Kazanlak to Kazanlak, about 1 h 41 of riding. On the way it passes Central Balkan - Sokolna Reserve, Central Balkan - Dzhendema Reserve and back through Central Balkan - Sokolna Reserve. The highest point is about 850 m. The line favours views over speed.
